_comment: Committed generation parameters for reproducibility (D-A12-2 discipline: every synthetic mechanism this app relies on is a published, seeded parameter, not a hidden default). The jar and raw CSV output are gitignored; this file is what's committed; the small deidentified preview under data/sample/ is regenerated locally by `make data`.
excluded_csv_files_reason: allergies, careplans, claims, claims_transactions, devices, imaging_studies, organizations, payers, payer_transitions, providers, supplies are Synthea outputs this app's features/labels/tools never read. Excluding them at generation time keeps disk and generation time down (D-A12-6, keep-it-simple).
